description: Get daily, weekly or monthly OHLC history per contract month for brent, wti or natural-gas (NYMEX Henry Hub) futures between two dates. Use when the user asks how a futures contract traded over time or for past settlements; opa_get_futures and opa_get_futures_curve return only the current front month and curve. The date range is at most 730 days and cannot include future dates. Pass contract_month (YYYY-MM) for one contract; without it every listed contract month is returned and the answer shows at most 400 rows, saying what it left out. Daily close is the last captured price; exchange settlement is shown where the API reports it. Futures data sits behind the API's futures entitlement. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

contract.description: Instrument: brent, wti, or natural-gas (default: brent).

interval.description: Bar size: daily, weekly or monthly (default: daily).

to.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today. At most 730 days after from.

name: opa_get_futures_history
title: Get Futures Settlement History
